actions.action: Tip the plant out and check whether the roots are circling
If rootbound, repot into a pot 1-2 inches wider with drainage, using half potting soil and half perlite or cactus mix, with the trunk base above the soil
If not repotting, top-dress with a half-inch layer of the mix over the exposed roots
Check the top inch of soil with a finger and water when dry

reason: The answer calls the plant healthy and makes repotting conditional on a root check, offering top-dressing as an equal alternative, so it only partly matches the confirmed rootbound diagnosis and fix; the root check would likely lead to repotting, so it is not harmful.
